title: Creation and Evaluation of a Pre-tertiary Artificial Intelligence (AI) Curriculum
reasoning: The paper describes the creation and evaluation of a pre-tertiary AI curriculum where ethics is a core component. The curriculum includes multiple chapters (10-12) and a dedicated module ('Ethics & Impact') focused on societal impact and the ethical use of AI. The evaluation of this curriculum's effectiveness inherently includes its ethical education component, making it a central theme rather than a peripheral consideration.
